Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL in new regions and compute generation

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL is now generally available in the following two regions:

  • Australia South East with Gen 5 compute
  • South India with Gen 5 compute

 

Also, Gen 5 compute is now generally available in the following regions in addition to previously available Gen 4 compute:

  • Brazil South
  • East US 2
  • Japan East
  • Japan West
  • South Central US
  • Southeast Asia

 

Learn more about regional availability.

Learn more about compute generations.

Learn more about migration to Azure Database for PostgreSQL.
